title: Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) - Finance Transformation
description:
Principal Consultant - Finance Transformation

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent

Empower finance leadership through strategic transformation

The Role

Capco is looking for Principal Consultants to join our growing Finance Transformation capability within the Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) practice. You'll play a key role in helping CFOs, Treasurers, and senior finance leaders maximise the value of their finance and treasury functions through operating model redesign, process transformation, and strategic technology delivery. You'll also leverage approved AI tools and AI-enabled ways of working to improve analysis, accelerate insight generation, and enhance delivery while applying responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

What You'll Do

• Deliver finance transformation programmes spanning regulatory change (including Basel, IFRS, and PRA), finance technology, process optimisation, and operating model transformation, identifying opportunities to leverage AI-enabled workflows and automation.

• Partner with CFOs, Treasurers, and C-suite stakeholders to implement finance strategies, strengthen controls, and optimise regulatory reporting, including ICAAP, ILAAP, and Recovery and Resolution Planning (RRP).

• Define business requirements and manage end-to-end project delivery across finance, treasury, and regulatory change initiatives, ensuring appropriate governance where AI-assisted tools are utilised.

• Design and implement stress testing frameworks across credit, market, and liquidity risk to support regulatory compliance and strategic decision-making, using AI-enabled analysis where appropriate.

• Collaborate with technology teams to embed digital, automation, and AI-enabled solutions into finance processes, architecture, and operating models to improve efficiency and business outcomes.

What We're Looking For

• Experience delivering finance transformation programmes within financial services or management consulting.

• Strong understanding of finance operating models, accounting processes, regulatory change, and financial reporting.

• Experience with finance technology implementations, including ERP platforms, subledgers, automation, and optimisation solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using approved AI tools to enhance analysis, productivity, and decision-making while maintaining sound professional judgement.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence audiences from project teams through to CFOs and executive leadership.

Bonus Points For

• Professional finance qualification such as ACA, ACCA, or CIMA.

• Familiarity with Basel, Solvency II, IFRS, SOX, PRA, or EBA regulatory requirements.

• Experience delivering finance transformation programmes involving RPA, cloud technologies, AI-enabled solutions, or Generative AI within finance functions.

• Strong business analysis or project management credentials such as Agile, PMI, or PRINCE2.

• Experience supporting business development, proposition development, leadership initiatives, or client growth.

Why Join Capco

• Deliver high-impact transformation programmes for Tier 1 financial institutions.

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, industry certifications, and structured career development.

• Help shape the future of finance transformation through innovation, automation, and technology.

• Be part of a team delivering meaningful change across financial services and energy.

Benefits

• Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.

• Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.

• Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave for sickness, pregn

description:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing - and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Enterprise Customer Success team advises and guides our largest customers, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We are the trusted point of contact for Samsara’s strategic customers throughout their lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, advocacy, and renewal. 

In this role, you will be part of our Implementation team, responsible for helping Enterprise customers deploy and adopt our IoT solutions for their fleet and industrial assets. Picking up where our sales teams leave off, you will own the customer relationship and ensure a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. Your customers span the entire range of businesses that power our economy, including trucking and transportation, food and beverage, passenger transit, utilities, school buses, and many others. This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to understand a customer’s business quickly, and comfort in explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. 

This is a remote role with 25% travel, open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

• You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

title: Inside Sales / Lead Generation: Construction
description:
Inside Sales / Lead Generation: Construction
The role
This is a hunting role. You'll find projects before they're on anyone else's radar; at the permit and pre-construction stage and figure out who's making decisions, get them on the phone, and book meetings for our reps. Two skills make someone great at this job. The first is research: you can start with a permit filing and end up with a construction manager's direct line. The second is the phone: you make a lot of calls, you're comfortable being the interruption, and a hang-up doesn't slow you down.
What you'll do
Find the opportunities

• Monitor municipal permit filings, planning applications, development approvals, and construction news across Ontario

• Identify projects at the permit and pre-construction phase

• Track which developers and general contractors are actively winning work

Map the decision-makers

• For every project, identify the developer, general contractor, construction manager, project manager, and purchasing lead

• Source names, titles, direct phone numbers, and email addresses

• Understand who controls the spec, who controls the budget, and who to call first

Work the phone

• Make a high volume of outbound cold calls every day

• Qualify interest, uncover project timelines, scope, and buying process

• Book qualified meetings for the sales team and hit a monthly meeting target

Build our intelligence in Salesforce

• Enter every project, contact, call outcome, and note: same day, complete, accurate

• Keep records clean enough that a rep can open one and walk into a meeting prepared

• Maintain the pipeline of tracked developments so nothing goes stale or gets missed

Hand off properly

• Brief the rep before each meeting: what the project is, who they're meeting, what was discussed, where the opening is
What we're looking for
You'll need

• 1-3+ years of outbound cold calling or prospecting where the phone was your primary tool: not email-only or inbound follow-up

• Proven comfort with high call volume

• Strong research instincts and genuine resourcefulness in finding contact information

• CRM experience (Salesforce strongly preferred) and the discipline to keep data clean

• Experience selling into construction, building products, real estate development, or skilled trades

• Familiarity with permit and planning data sources: municipal portals, ConstructConnect, Dodge, BuildingConnected, or similar

• Understanding of multifamily construction phases and who buys what, when

What we offer

• $60,000 base salary

• Performance bonus tied to qualified meetings booked

title: Medicare Compliance & QA Associate

We're building healthcare tech for a system that desperately needs it.

Each year, millions of Americans deal with confusing changes to their Medicare plans that impact their prescriptions, access to care, and pocketbooks. These aren’t just inconveniences - they are potentially life-altering changes that leave seniors medically and financially vulnerable.

Independent Medicare advisors play a crucial role in guiding seniors through this complexity and helping them find the right coverage for their needs. But their ability to be effective healthcare advocates has long been hamstrung by broken tools and outdated systems.

Spark is fixing that. We’re the fastest-growing Medicare platform in the country, combining AI, an industry-leading CRM, and client services to transform how 10,000+ brokers acquire, enroll, and support clients in their local communities.

Join a talent-dense team from Square, Ramp, Yext, Oscar, and Cedar - backed by Primary Ventures and Viewpoint Ventures - that is serious about building technology to expand access to quality healthcare. We offer remote work, sabbaticals, company retreats, and other generous benefits that earned us recognition as one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces of 2025

Healthcare is overdue for innovation. Let’s redefine what its future looks like - together.

Summary
Spark is hiring an Associate, Medicare Compliance & Quality Assurance responsible for supporting the organization’s compliance operations by managing case intake, tracking case progress, facilitating communication between carriers and agents, and assisting with agent coaching. Operational Support (10%)

title: Expert Audio Transcriber, Tunisian Arabic
description:
ABOUT PERLE
Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. Our partners include xAI, Samsung, ELM, and Unisys. Headquartered in San Francisco with experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.
Apply here:
THE ROLE
We are hiring expert Tunisian Arabic transcribers to convert audio recordings of native speakers into precise, conventionally formatted written transcripts. The work powers speech recognition, dialogue, and evaluation systems for major AI labs. Audio ranges from clean studio recordings to natural conversational speech in real-world acoustic conditions.
You will be working at the level of expert linguistic judgment. This is not data entry. Decisions about orthography, code-switching, speaker attribution, disfluencies, and non-speech events shape the quality of every model trained on your output.
DIALECT AND SCOPE
Tunisian Arabic (Tounsi / Derja), a Maghrebi variety with substantial Berber, French, and Italian lexical influence. Project audio reflects everyday Tunisian speech with frequent code-switching to French.
Primary speaker regions: Tunis, Sfax, Sousse, Kairouan, Bizerte, Gabes.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Transcribe audio recordings into accurate, time-aligned written text following Perle's project-specific style guide

• Apply correct conventions for speaker identification, overlapping speech, disfluencies, fillers, false starts, and non-speech events such as laughter, background noise, and music

• Make principled orthographic decisions for dialectal, colloquial, and code-switched speech

• Flag ambiguous segments, uncertain speakers, and audio quality issues using project conventions

• Self-review every submission against Perle's quality bar before delivery

• Engage with QA reviewers on edge cases, calibration sessions, and style guide updates

MUST HAVE

• Native fluency in Tunisian Arabic with lifelong residence or deep immersion in Tunisia

• Strong command of Modern Standard Arabic for orthographic decisions on Derja speech

• Working knowledge of French sufficient to transcribe French loanwords and code-switching

• Familiarity with regional Tunisian variation across coastal and inland areas

• At least two years of professional transcription, captioning, court reporting, broadcast, translation, or linguistic annotation experience

• Demonstrated accuracy at the word level under deadline pressure

• Comfortable with web-based annotation platforms and variable-speed audio playback

• Reliable high-speed internet, quality headphones, and a quiet workspace

• Ability to commit to defined volume per week during active project phases

NICE TO HAVE

• Background in Maghrebi Arabic linguistics, translation, or journalism

• Prior experience annotating Tunisian or Maghrebi speech data

• Working knowledge of Tamazight or Italian for additional lexical cases

• Familiarity with IPA or other phonetic transcription systems

• Experience with verbatim versus clean-verbatim transcription conventions

HOW WE WORK WITH YOU

• Paid pilot task before full onboarding so both sides can calibrate

• Per-task or per-minute compensation, with rates tied to audio complexity and turnaround

• Flexible scheduling, with volume scaling up and down based on active client projects

• Direct working relationship with Perle's linguistic leads and QA team

• Eligible for invitation to additional Perle expert projects across related domains

HOW TO APPLY
Apply through Winnow, Perle's job portal at winnow.perle.ai. Find the role for your language under Open Jobs, set up your candidate profile, and complete the fully automated interview, which takes about 25 minutes. We review applications within 24 hours and invite passing candidates straight to the project.

- HAZOP

- Functional Failure Analysis

- Operational Risk Assessment

- Safety Gap Analysis

- Brake-by-Wire systems

- Steer-by-Wire systems

- Throttle-by-Wire systems

- Shift / Transmission-by-Wire systems

- Emergency Stop systems

- Autonomous motion control systems

- Remote operation functions

- Support architecture reviews and identify safety gaps across sensing, compute, controls, hydraulics, actuation, communication, and operational processes

title: Systems Engineer - Database Platform
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

 Available Locations: Austin, New York, San Francisco

About the Team

We manage an internal, multi-region PostgreSQL platform that enables engineers to rapidly build, deploy, and operate services. Our mission is to provide a highly available, stable, and self-service platform with clear operational visibility. As a Systems Engineer, you will collaborate with database engineers, developers, and infrastructure teams to evolve our database architecture and automation. You will be instrumental in scaling our PostgreSQL infrastructure and enhancing database reliability. If you are passionate about PostgreSQL, automation, reliability, and database tooling, let's connect!

Role Responsibilities

• Build, deploy, and manage PostgreSQL database clusters in production environments. 

• Develop and maintain database tooling for automation, monitoring and performance tuning.

• Implement high availability, backup and disaster recovery solutions. 

• Work closely with Infrastructure and Applications teams to integrate database tools. 

• Implement proactive solutions using observability tools to monitor database health. 

• Optimize database performance, indexing strategies, and query tuning. 

Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)

Must-Have Skills

• Experience with building, scaling, and managing large-scale multi-tenant PostgreSQL database clusters, encompassing high availability failover, and disaster recovery strategies.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible or Salt) .

• Experience in scripting languages (Python, Bash) for automation. 

• Experience building and maintaining database tooling for automation and monitoring.

• Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.

• Experience optimizing database performance and query tuning.

• Experience with alerting and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana.

title: ESG & Environmental and Social Management Consultant (C-26-14)
description:
This is a remote position.
The International Potato Center (CIP) is strengthening its institutional approach to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) and Environmental and Social Management (ESM), appropriate to its mandate as an international agricultural research organization, its decentralized operating model, and the environmental and social risks associated with its research, operations, projects, partnerships and field activities.
Benchmarking with other CGIAR Centers and the CGIAR System Organization indicates ESG should not be treated solely as a sustainability reporting exercise: a credible approach also requires mechanisms to identify, assess, manage, monitor and evidence environmental and social risks across the organization and project lifecycle.CIP's approach therefore spans two complementary dimensions:

• Institutional ESG and sustainability - CIP's own environmental, social and governance responsibilities and performance; and

• Project-level environmental and social safeguards - risks and impacts associated with research, projects, field activities, partners, suppliers and communities.

CIP intends to build on its existing governance, enterprise risk management, project management, partner management and internal control arrangements, rather than establish a separate ESG structure. At the same time, CIP wishes to: become ready to demonstrate alignment with ISO 14001; establish a credible and proportionate ESG framework; strengthen safeguards to meet Green Climate Fund (GCF) and comparable climate-finance requirements; understand GCF requirements beyond ISO 14001; understand how far existing fiduciary and institutional systems already support GCF readiness; and build a baseline that responds efficiently to other donors
Objective:
The purpose of the consultancy is to establish where CIP is today; what target ESG and Environmental & Social Management architecture is appropriate for CIP; what gaps exist against ISO, GCF and relevant donor expectations; and what practical, proportionate steps CIP should take to close them.
The assignment is structured as three sequential phases. Phase 1 is scoped as a self-contained diagnostic and policy engagement that CIP can commission and complete on its own. Phases 2 and 3 build on Phase 1's findings and are intended to be scoped in detail - and commissioned - once Phase 1 is complete, so that their design reflects what the baseline and gap analysis actually show, rather than being fixed in advance.
This consultancy advertisement is for Phase 1 only. Phases 2 and 3 are indicative future phases and will be scoped and commissioned separately based on the findings of Phase 1.
The consultant should havedemonstrated experience assessing and designing ESG and environmental and social management frameworks in international or decentralized organizations. The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise in ISO 14001, environmental and social safeguards and climate-finance requirements with the ability to translate international standards into practical and proportionate institutional arrangements.
Deliverables:
Phase 1 - Diagnose and Frame (4-6 weeks)
Establish where CIP stands today against ISO 14001, institutional ESG maturity, GCF environmental and social safeguards readiness, and broader donor requirements. Deliver a validated current-state and maturity assessment, an integrated gap analysis, a draft CIP ESG/Environmental and Social Management Policy, and a management briefing with recommendations on Phase 2/3 scope and sequencing. Phase 1 is a self-contained engagement that CIP can act independently. See Annex A for the full topic taxonomy: environmental, social and governance sub-areas).

• D1.2 - CIP Current-State and Maturity Assessment

• D1.3 - Integrated Gap Analysis (ISO / ESG / GCF safeguards / broader GCF institutional map / other donors)

• D1.4 - Draft CIP ESG / Environmental & Social M

description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the business in meeting its regulatory obligations and managing enterprise risk.

The Product Compliance team is responsible for embedding compliance into the product lifecycle and supporting the compliant development, launch and ongoing operation of OKX products and features globally across all markets in which our products and services are offered. We work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to identify regulatory and compliance requirements, assess product risks and develop practical solutions that support responsible commercial growth.

About the Opportunity

 We are seeking an experienced, hands-on and commercially minded Senior Compliance Manager to join our Product Compliance team.
This is a senior individual-contributor role focused primarily on the day-to-day review of new products, material product changes and existing product enhancements. The emphasis is on delivering timely, well-reasoned product compliance assessments using a risk-based approach, ensuring that material compliance risks are sufficiently mitigated and the firm’s regulatory positioning protected.

You will act as a trusted compliance partner throughout the product development lifecycle, helping Product and Engineering teams navigate complex regulatory requirements while enabling commercially viable outcomes. You will be expected to distinguish between legal or regulatory constraints that cannot be crossed, risks that can be addressed through proportionate controls, and residual risks that require documented escalation or risk acceptance.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

•

• Own and deliver day-to-day compliance reviews of new products, features, market expansions and material changes to existing products across OKX's global business and product suite.

• Review product requirements, technical documentation, user journeys, onboarding flows, trading or transaction mechanics, reward structures, disclosures and operational processes.

• Apply a risk-based waterfall that distinguishes hard legal or regulatory blockers from risks that may be addressed through controls, product conditions, jurisdictional restrictions, monitoring or escalation.

• Conduct and document product compliance risk assessments covering areas such as regulatory perimeter and licensing, AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC, consumer protection, financial promotions, trading and market conduct, asset safeguarding, data privacy and third-party risk.

• Produce clear, concise and evidence-based and solutions-based compliance recommendations setting out identified risks, required mitigants, residual exposure and the proposed approval or escalation route.

• Work directly with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to develop practical and scalable solutions to identified compliance requirements.

• Maintain complete and accurate documentation and audit trails for product reviews, decisions, conditions, exceptions, approvals

The Account Management Lead - Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead - Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

- Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.
Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.
Position Title: Commissioning Project Manager
Position Location: Remote - United States. Must be located near a major airport.
Travel Requirements: Up to 50% domestic travel. Must have a valid driver’s license and ability to rent vehicles.
JOB SUMMARY
The Commissioning Project Manager provides technical support and leadership to plan, schedule and execute full life cycle commissioning of critical facilities. This person participates in the MEP design review process and participates in functional testing of complex electrical and mechanical systems.
The Commissioning Project Manager is responsible for supporting all aspects of a project. This person will work as part of the project team and interact closely with the owners, designers, contractors, subcontractors and other trades on projects in mission critical environments.
The role may assist with developing and evaluating bid proposals, developing commissioning plans and schedules, facilitating communication and ensuring compliance with owner’s requirements, applicable laws, and specifications.
This person will collaborate with design engineers, construction contractors, equipment vendors, client staff and the DLB commissioning team to test, validate and make operational newly installed and operational electrical and mechanical systems including those in mission critical facilities.
The Commissioning Project Manager will receive limited directions on day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute commissioning and assist project leadership on projects of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision.
This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Manage all Elements of Commissioning Projects (50%)

• Assist with pre-construction elements including project initiation, kickoff, RFIs and submittals

• Coordinate and support resource and material forecasting

• Develop, manage and monitor schedule

• Participate in, schedule or lead project meetings

• Coordinate / perform QA / QC and Cx plans and specifications to ensure completion in accordance with the project scope and appropriate guidelines and manuals

• Communicate and coordinate project staffing needs.

• Coordinate or oversee start-up, cutover, pre-functional or functional testing and project closeout

• Onboard project team for mobilization

• Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders

• Lead and assist in preparation of final commissioning report for submission to client

Monitor and Control Project Financials (15%)

• Prepare, forecast and monitor project budgets, profitability, margins, bill rates and utilization and maintain overall responsibility for the profitability of the project

• Communicate with the client when additional fees / change orders are required

• Identify potential project risks and develop / implement strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines

Manage Stakeholder Relations (15%)

• Assist in the preparation of proposals, presentations and the overall marketing efforts of the firm

• Assist in the promotion of the firm, service and expertise to existing or potential clients

• Maintain client relationship to ensure an ongoing positive relationship and work with clients to identify and develop new projects

• Support contact for clients and build effect

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners. 

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

As a Senior Pre-Sales Engineer, you are a "developer-plus" technical contributor. You are responsible for building high-quality mock backends, APIs, and demo infrastructure, but with a unique twist: you leverage LLMs and Generative AI to prototype at high velocity.

This role sits at the critical boundary between Product Engineering and Go-to-Market. While you won't build production systems, you will build "production-shaped" assets: reusable, well-structured, and documented services that enable credible technical storytelling and high-fidelity client validation.

Your core responsibilities will include:

- AI-Accelerated Prototyping: Leverage LLMs (e.g., Claude and Gemini) to rapidly scaffold, build, and iterate on proof-of-concept apps and mock services. You move faster than a traditional sprint by using AI to handle the "heavy lifting" of boilerplate and logic generation.

- Technical Asset Development: Design, build, and maintain reusable mock services in Node.js / TypeScript. You’ll implement contract-first APIs (REST/GraphQL), manage AWS deployments (API Gateway, Containers), and handle persistence using PostgreSQL or DynamoDB

- Infrastructure as Code: Manage demo environments using Terraform, ensuring environments are reproducible and secure using existing OIDC authentication patterns.

- Frontend Collaboration: Work closely with frontend engineers to ensure UI components point cleanly to your mock services, debugging integration issues and supporting end-to-end demo flows.

- Strategic Pre-Sales Support: Partner with Pre-Sales consultants to translate client "win themes" into working technical artefacts. You will occasionally demo directly to clients, showcasing how Kaluza solves their specific retail challenges.

- Product & UX Influence: Collaborate with Design and Product teams for UI direction while developing your own design ideas to make Kaluza’s capabilities shine.

- Mentorship & Standards: Set informal engineering standards for the pre-sales team, mentoring others on API design and architecture.

- AI Evangelism: Act as the resident expert in GenAI workflows for the Commercial team, mentoring others on how to use AI to bridge the gap between "slide-ware" and "software."

What this role is NOT:

- A pure presentation-led role (you will be writing code regularly).

- Shipping production code (your value comes from building things that work for a demo, not maintaining production SLOs).

About You

You are a software engineer by trade but a prototyper by heart. You understand the rigour of clean code but know when to lean into AI to accelerate delivery. You are motivated by the immediate impact of winning new clients and validating Kaluza’s value proposition in real-time.

title: System Integration and Test Engineer, Space Systems
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Space Manufacturing team is seeking a System Integration and Test Engineer to join our team. The Space Manufacturing team is responsible for assembly, integration, and test of ground support equipment, PCBA, unit-level, and integrated systems that are vital for our aerospace and defense operations. Your expertise will help ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability at Anduril. The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership in solving a technical challenge with a creative, physical solution that they either personally manufactured or oversaw the manufacturing of, in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

• Lead and participate in system integration and test campaigns, developing test plans, test procedures, and schedules, coordinating resource needs, test equipment, and test facility needs.

• Lead test readiness reviews (TRRs) for flight hardware.

• Participate in manufacturing readiness reviews (MRRs) for flight hardware.

• Develop, document, and continuously improve processes for the manufacturing, assembly, and integration of PCBAs and box-level assemblies, and space vehicles, ensuring compliance with space-grade standards.

• Perform hands-on hardware and software testing at unit-level and system level.

• Perform detailed root cause analyses (RCA) and drive corrective actions for non-conformances/anomalies identified during integration and test.

• Specify, procure, and maintain assembly tools, fixtures, and equipment required for integration and test.

• Communicate with supply chain, hardware teams, program management, and test teams to manage priorities and resolve technical challenges.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• 5+ years of experience in aerospace, aviation, military, or other high-reliability industries, including 2+ years in hands-on integration and test of flight or comparably high-reliability hardware.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another technical discipline.

• A working, cross-disciplinary understanding of both mechanical and electrical engineering - comfortable interpreting mechanical drawings and GD&T as well as electrical schematics, troubleshooting across both mechanical hardware and electrical/electronic systems, and interfacing with design engineers to address DFM/DFA challenges.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in unit-level, space-vehicle, or system integration, assembly, and environmental testing, with direct involvement in at least 2 of: vibration, thermal vacuum, acoustic, shock, or EMI/EMC.

• Hands-on integration or test experience with electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) or comparable sensor and payload systems - at least 1 such area, and preferably more than one (e.g., EO/IR, RF/communications, or optical instruments).

• 3+ years of practical, hands-on experience using test equipment such as oscilloscopes, network analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, and DAQs.
